problem: Concurrent stale recoveries can append multiple recovery claims for the same opportunity before seeing each other, producing duplicate recovery work and collision-reconciliation overhead.
acceptance: At most one active recovery attempt per opportunity and recovery generation proceeds under simultaneous launches.
Losers persist a collision receipt and do not start substantive recovery work.
Late original returns and late recovery returns remain immutable evidence and are reconciled.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or global-authority promotion.
title: Single-winner recovery arbitration canary
mission: Build and falsify a recovery-claim arbitration layer that turns simultaneous stale-takeover attempts into exactly one substantive recovery plus append-only loser collision receipts, while preserving late original/recovery evidence and the existing stale thresholds/authority boundaries.

incident_repair.reason: The live broad /wc wave produced multiple simultaneous recovery claims on the same stale opportunities; kernel recovery had to reconcile three competing recovery runs, while mobile discover and Facultad intent each acquired multiple near-simultaneous recovery attempts.

unblock_value.reason: Reducing recovery duplication preserves worker capacity for newly-ready successor work and lowers collision reconciliation overhead during high-parallelism waves.

regression_prevention.reason: A simultaneous-launch falsifier can detect regressions where append-only recovery evidence remains safe but multiple workers still perform the same substantive recovery.

falsification.pass: Exactly one attempt receives substantive-recovery authority; every loser emits an append-only collision receipt without executing target recovery; a late original RETURN remains preserved and reconciled.
falsification.fail: Two or more attempts perform substantive recovery, any loser overwrites evidence, or a late original/recovery RETURN is discarded.
